acceptance_criteria: Expose one documented version-1 library API for a single completed battle. Compose the actual existing runBattle and keep its explicit ps/seeds/limits/preparedTeams/streamFactory contract where supported; default policies remain the existing randomPolicy and optional callbacks retain exactly the existing history/request/random input API. No existing source module changes are planned; report concrete evidence to primary before any necessary scope adjustment.

Emit a serializable allowlisted artifact with pinned format/upstream identity, validated public terminal outcome and two separate player trajectories. Each per-player sample has contiguous decision index, positive current request-episode ID, request kind, own current request snapshot, eleven-slot mask, selected slot/command and an own-history delta captured before that policy selects an action. Do not store RNG functions, seeds, packed teams, raw packets, trusted transcript/end metadata, arbitrary result/config fields or opponent-private data in decision observations.

Use Task028 actionSpace/decodeAction and only current-episode rejection evidence when recording masks and validating the chosen command. Sampling must consume no additional policy RNG draws. Return only valid actionable decisions: wait/forceSwitch false and duplicate unresolved requests yield no extra samples. Identical request payloads in later episodes remain separate samples; retries remain distinguishable in their original episode.

Capture immutable or detached snapshots before user-policy invocation; per-player history deltas must reconstruct exactly the callback-visible history prefix at each successive decision, including non-actionable requests/events/resolutions received between callbacks. Do not truncate older knowledge or copy each complete history at every step. A final selected command has no invented submission/resolution status, and post-final-decision observations are explicitly outside this initial schema.

Store terminal reward targets separately per fixed seat: winner +1, loser -1, tie 0. No alternating-player sign convention and no reward/outcome/future-opponent field may be added to policy callback input or a pre-action observation. Mark behavior probability/log probability unavailable (null or explicitly omitted with documentation); do not fabricate training likelihoods.

Fail safely without returning a completed or partial dataset when runBattle, configuration, policy invocation or action validation fails. Use fixed diagnostics and do not copy arbitrary exception properties/result-shaped metadata into output. Do not expose a collector snapshot accessor that can masquerade as a successful dataset after failure.

Add independent scripted-stream tests for exact snapshots/history reconstruction, interleaved and consecutive own decisions, forced replacement, wait/no-choice, duplicate pending vs repeated later requests, unavailable-choice retry/exclusion reset, all three terminal reward cases, invalid selection/config/policy/runner failures, detached data and strict output allowlisting. Use concrete expected fields rather than only comparing the collector against its own helpers.

Enforce non-leakage with paired controlled streams that keep one actor callback history/current request identical while varying opponent private requests/split branches and pending choices or hidden end metadata. Require equal recorded actor observations/masks/selected actions under the same policy RNG. Explicitly keep post-game targets separate. Complete a real guarded pinned battle, verify masks/commands, own-side request histories and terminal target mapping, and compare policy command sequences with unwrapped runBattle under the same seeds to show recording changes no decisions.

Document API, JSON schema, privacy/target boundary, episode/retry responsibilities, delta reconstruction, unavailable likelihoods and completion-only/final-tail limitations in README.
